note: Drag Race's music: the show's own cues only, never another show's. Every file is the user's own copy (Downloads/RPDR soundtrack), kept in private/ (git-ignored, never published); a copy without them is silent there. Each cue is named for its moment and fitted to it (music.js): `at` skips an intro, `hit` lands on the card it scores, `outro` + `head` let a cue longer than its moment be cut to it. critiques = Top & Bottom (Dredmill); decision, suspense, crowning = I've Made My Decision (The Last Sun, short cut); up-for-elimination = Strobophobia; bottom-two = Ephemeral Faze; time-has-come = Earthrise; verdict (the pause, shantay, sashay, a lip sync's winner, her walk off) = The Last Sun; closing = If You Can't Love Yourself (Bad Like Yaz). The runway, the entrances, the returns, the crowning walk, the finale's opening and the reunion play the season's host song (music.js HOST_SONG). Offsets measured at 0.25 s resolution, 2026-09-30. Each cue plays ONLY at the moment it is named for: reusing Earthrise under every tear and Ephemeral Faze under every argument put the lip sync's announcement music in the werk room (the user: "i still dont hear the soundtrack in the correct place"). Drama, tears, comedy, sweet and romance are silent until cues of their own arrive. 2026-09-30, the user's beds (Downloads/RPDR Music): entrances = Arrivals; werkroom = Werkroom (cold open, morning, mini, announcement, the choice, elimination day); prep = Rehearsal and Rehearsal#2 in turn; challenge = Challenge Music and #2 in turn; chal-rusical = the Rusical's own; untucked = Untucked. A mood scene with no cue of its own keeps the room's bed (music.js MOODS).
